name: OpenVibe.Billing

exposure.note: the public domain is the staff console; accounts pay through each product

liveness.means: the process answers and reads the economy freeze flag from its database; it reports the authority, providers and relay but checks no dependency

drains: job timers cleared (provider-event retry, renewal sweep, reconciliation)
outbox relay and Network key refresh stopped

resumes.what: stored provider events without processed_at are processed again every minute (processPending); each applies at most once
the hourly subscription renewal sweep and the reconciliation run (first one 60 s after boot) pick up what fell due
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.what: a stored provider event (provider_events row) while it is applied
claims.holder: the connection that takes the SQLite write lock (IMMEDIATE transaction)
claims.expires: at commit or rollback of that transaction
claims.fencing: processed_at is re-read inside the transaction, so a second process or connection that waited applies nothing; ledger postings carry idempotency keys

notes: The isolated money ledger (ADR-012): balanced append-only journal, provider receipts, subscriptions/entitlements, refunds and payouts. Alpha, shadow mode: Live stays authoritative for money until the Wave 8 cutover; Billing imports and reconciles.
